Title: Azure Spot Virtual Machines are now generally available

Body.Content:
Access unused Azure compute capacity at deep discounts compared to pay-as-you-go prices with Azure Spot Virtual Machines. Spot Virtual Machines provide scalability while reducing costs and they’re ideal for workloads that can be interrupted. Get unique Azure pricing and benefits when running Windows Server workloads on Spot Virtual Machines.

Take advantage of Spot pricing for Azure Virtual Machines or Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Select the right deployment model based on your preferences and the characteristics of your application. Spot Virtual Machines are suitable to run workloads that don’t need to be completed within a specific timeframe. 

The offering is now generally available in most Azure regions.

See more information
